title: Variance and the constant Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. If the uniform variance of $f$ is at most $1/2$, then the square of its Fourier coefficient at the empty set is at least $1/2$.
hypotheses_covered: The uniform variance of $f$ is at most $1/2$
